_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Packaging Development Data Report
summary: This DID defines the packaging identification data required for a Packaging Development Data Report used to develop adequate DoD packaging instructions.
use_relationship:
This report contains basic identification data required for packaging development. The report can be used as a standalone summary to develop adequate packaging instructions for DoD users.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for a Packaging Development Data Report.
b. This DID is applicable to the acquisition of military systems and equipment.
c. This DID supersedes DI-PACK-81582A
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and the dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report may be prepared in a contractor-selected format so long as it contains the information required for a Packaging Development Data Report.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The data required for the Packaging Development Data Report is identified below. These data elements are defined in SAE GEIA-STD-0007.
